battle.name: 金軍三道攻宋之戰
battle.brief: 1219年初，金宣宗以僕散安貞為統帥，分兵三道南侵：西路出唐、鄧趨襄漢，中路出蔡、息向江漢，東路由宿州趨泗、濠。騎兵穿插配合砲擊攻城，兩淮與襄樊同時受壓；宋將趙方、孟宗政等以城守與砲反制，金軍終未能渡江。配重投石車正是攻樊城、光州時壓制城頭的攻城器械。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是金與南宋，第三方則是西夏與蒙古：西夏在1220年一度與宋約定夾攻金朝，蒙古則從北面牽制金朝，是理解這場戰爭的前提。金朝在女真完顏氏統治下，都城已於1214年由中都燕京南遷汴京（南京），宣宗完顏珣在位，中樞由尚書省與樞密院分掌，前線則以行院與行元帥府分置。金軍的編制在此時已經高度分層：後方設行院於中京，各路分遣樞密院事；西路的唐、鄧設行元帥府，由行元帥府事完顏訛論與元帥右都監孛朮魯達阿指揮；中路蔡、息設行元帥府，由元帥府右都監斡勒合打主持；東路宿州設行院，由簽樞密院事納合降福節制；全軍以元帥僕散安貞統攝。兵源是女真猛安謀克為主的騎兵，加上大量以簽軍方式強徵而來的漢人步卒，這支部隊騎兵銳利、步兵不堪遠戰，戰史上屢見金軍因糧道不繼而中途退兵。南宋一方以京湖制置司掌襄、鄂，以江淮制置司掌兩淮，以四川宣撫司掌蜀口；趙方於1219年冬調集六萬人分三路北攻，是這次反攻的骨幹。地方武裝亦參戰：孟宗政收編中原歸宋之民組成忠順軍，李全所部紅襖軍已降宋並在兩淮獨當一面。雙方的力量對比一目了然：金以騎兵與攻城器械見長，糧秣與士氣卻短；宋以城守、砲位與水陸之利見長，野戰兵力則薄。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Jin and the Southern Song; the third parties were Western Xia and the Mongols, and the brief alliance between Xia and Song in 1220 and the Mongol pressure from the north are the setting without which this war cannot be understood. The Jin, ruled by the Jurchen house of Wanyan, had moved its capital south from Zhongdu (Yanjing) to Bianjing (Nanjing) in 1214, and under the Xuanzong, Wanyan Xun, the central government divided authority between the Department of State Affairs and the Privy Council, while the fronts were held by separate field offices and campaign headquarters. The army was by now strictly tiered: a field office at Zhongdu in the rear, with privy councillors dispatched to the several circuits; a campaign headquarters at Tang and Deng in the west, commanded by the headquarters commander Wanyan Nelun together with the right commander Boluoluda; a campaign headquarters at Cai and Xi in the centre, under the right commander Woluoheda; a field office at Suzhou in the east, controlled by the co-signatory of the privy council Nahelie Jiangfu; and the whole force coordinated by the marshal Pus'an Anzhen. Its manpower was cavalry drawn mainly from the Jurchen meng'an mouke, together with a large body of Han foot soldiers seized for service under the qianjun system: sharp enough on the ride, unreliable on the march, and the records are full of Jin armies turning back for want of grain. On the Southern Song side, the Jinghu circuit command held Xiang and E, the Jianghuai circuit command held the two Huai, and the Sichuan pacification office held the western mouth of the Sichuan basin; the backbone of the counter-stroke of 1219 was the sixty thousand men Zhao Fang gathered to send north in three columns. Local armed forces took part too: Meng Zongzheng enrolled the refugees who had come south from the central plain as the Zhongshun army, and Li Quan's Red Jacket force, already surrendered to Song, operated on its own in the two Huai. The balance of forces is plain from the outset: the Jin were strong in cavalry and siege engines but short of rations and shaky in morale; Song was strong in walls, gun positions and the advantage of water and land, but thin in the open field.
people: 金方留下姓名的多集中在統帥與統兵官。宣宗完顏珣是這場戰爭的決策者：他1213年即位，1214年被迫放棄中都南遷汴京，1216年二月下詔伐宋，1217年又以歲幣不至為名命烏古論慶壽經略南邊，1219年再以僕散安貞為統帥分兵三路。他生性猜忌，內廷連年變動，1219年末至1220年初又誅術虎高琪，前線將領也屢因被疑而牽連。僕散安貞是1219年三路大軍的元帥，1221年再率軍南侵至漢陽軍，抵長江而還。完顏訛論任唐、鄧行元帥府事，曾力卻宋人對唐、鄧的包圍，其後與宋人戰於唐州境上，士卒死者七百餘人，他卻匿敗以捷聞，事後被御史發覺；此事最能說明金軍的虛報與軍紀。孛朮魯達阿、斡勒合打、納合降福分任西、中、東三路主帥，訛可則在1222年奉命節制三路軍馬渡淮，高塘市一役擊破官軍，回師卻遭襲覆沒。宋方以趙方為橫紐：他在1219年十月先發制人，分派扈再興、許國、孟宗政三將率六萬人北攻，並戒令毋深入、毋攻城，只潰保甲、毀城砦、空資糧。孟宗政在唐、鄧、棗陽一線最見其能：他夜入金營，自晡至三更，殺金眾三萬，追至馬磴寨焚其城，擒金千戶趙興兒，又在湖陽再敗金軍；中原遺民歸宋者以萬數，被他編為忠順軍，金人呼之為孟爺爺。許國部將耶律均於比陽勝金軍，殺其將李提控；扈再興攻鄧州、邀擊天長，是西路與襄漢戰線的支柱。黃州守將何大節自沈於江，蘄州知州李誠之全家赴水而死，說明守城失敗時要付出什麼。安丙在四川與西夏議定夾攻，派王仕信、質俊、李實、張威、程信、陳立、田冒、陳昱分道出擊，是宋夏聯合攻金的第一次大規模嘗試。李全以紅襖軍降宋，1222年在淮上大敗金軍，也是這場戰爭裡宋方少數漂亮的野戰。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive on the Jin side are for the most part marshals and commanders. Xuanzong, Wanyan Xun, was the man who decided this war: he took the throne in 1213, was forced to abandon Zhongdu and move south to Bianjing in 1214, ordered the campaign against Song in the second month of 1216, and in 1217 once more took the pretext of unpaid tribute to set Wugulun Qinghou in charge of the southern front; in 1219 he appointed Pus'an Anzhen marshal and divided the army into three columns. He was by nature suspicious, the inner court was turned over repeatedly, and at the turn of 1219 and 1220 he put Shuohu Gaoqi to death; commanders in the field were repeatedly implicated by his doubts. Pus'an Anzhen was the marshal of the three armies in 1219, and in 1221 he led a fresh invasion south as far as Hanyang Army, stopping at the Yangtze. Wanyan Nelun served as headquarters commander at Tang and Deng, held off a Song encirclement of Tang and Deng by force, and later fought the Song on the borders of Tang prefecture, where seven hundred of his men were dead, yet he concealed the defeat and reported it as a victory until a censor exposed it; that single episode shows the falsification of reports and the discipline of the Jin army better than anything else. Boluoluda, Woluoheda and Nahelie Jiangfu commanded the western, central and eastern columns respectively, and in 1222 Nelcuo was ordered to take charge of the three columns and cross the Huai, breaking the Song army at Gaotang market and then losing everything on the way back. On the Song side the hinge was Zhao Fang: in the tenth month of 1219 he struck first, sending Huo Zaixing, Xu Guo and Meng Zongzheng north with sixty thousand men in three columns, and enjoining them not to penetrate deeply and not to besiege cities but only to break the garrisons, destroy the forts and empty the stores. Meng Zongzheng showed his quality on the Tang, Deng and Zaoyang line: he entered the Jin camp by night, from the late afternoon until the third watch, killed some thirty thousand of the enemy, pursued them to the Mateng stockade and burned it, captured the Jin commander of a thousand Zhao Xing'er, and beat the Jin again at Huyang; the people of the central plain who came south to him numbered in the tens of thousands, and he enrolled them as the Zhongshun army, whereupon the Jin called him Master Meng. Xu Guo's officer Yelü Jun beat the Jin at Biyang and killed their commander Li the Controller; Huo Zaixing attacked Deng prefecture and ambushed the Jin at Tianchang, holding up the western column and the Xiang-Han line. He Dajie, the defender of Huang prefecture, drowned himself in the river, and Li Chengzhi, governor of Qi prefecture, took his whole family into the water with him, which shows what the failure of a siege could cost. An Bing in Sichuan settled with Western Xia on a joint attack and sent Wang Shixin, Zhi Jun, Li Shi, Zhang Wei, Cheng Xin, Chen Li, Tian Mao and Chen Yu out by several roads, the first large-scale attempt at a Song-Xia joint offensive against the Jin. Li Quan, whose Red Jacket force had gone over to Song, defeated the Jin on the Huai in 1222, one of the few clean field victories Song won in this war.
kits: 卡面上這件配重投石車是地中海世界成熟的攻城器械：長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆，12世紀初已在西亞與歐洲的圍城戰中屢見。中國的對應器械是拋石車，宋金兩方的記錄中多稱砲或飛石砲，形制同屬配重梢砲一族：以木架立軸，長梢一端懸配重，另一端兜石，發射時先以人力絞索蓄勢，再放開扣發，單發拋石一至數枚，一具需數十人操作，因石重反震，必須以車廂或土壘遮蔽。這次戰爭的攻城場面正是這類器械的舞台：1219年金軍三道南下後，樊城、光州、黃州一線相繼遭到砲擊，樊城被急攻三日不克而退，砲是守城一方壓制城頭、護住城垣的直接手段；金軍攻黃州、蘄州與漢陽軍時同樣倚仗砲與雲梯、穴地一類攻城具，黃州、蘄州兩城因而先破。守城一方也用砲反制：孟宗政在唐、鄧一線以砲打擊金人的攻城器具，砲位與城垣同為宋軍抵住騎兵衝擊的依靠。除此之外，弩仍是城頭主幹，床子弩與神臂弓一類強弩居高臨下封住城門與馬道；火藥一端則有霹靂砲，發射鐵碎或碎塊，1211年楚州之戰已有記錄，與配重拋石車分屬冷兵器砸擊與火藥投擲兩條路子，說明當時攻城技術已不止一途。雙方步卒裝備以皮甲、札甲為主，女真騎兵披掛較重、衝撞有力，漢軍步卒則多靠長槍、刀與盾結陣。攻城戰的消耗極大：兵糧需自中京、河南一路輾轉運到前線，馬匹靠就地徵發與徵用，金史屢見乏糧而還的記載；渡淮則靠臨時編造的木橋，橋一破即成全軍之患。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card was a mature siege engine of the Mediterranean world: a long arm and a counterweight threw the stone over the wall, and by the early twelfth century it was already a familiar sight in the sieges of West Asia and Europe. The Chinese counterpart was the pao, the stone-throwing engine, called pao or feishi pao in the records of both Song and Jin, and belonging to the same family of counterweight machines: a wooden frame carrying an axle, a long throwing arm with a counterweight at one end and a sling of stone at the other, cocked by hauling a rope with manpower and released by a catch, throwing one stone or several in a single discharge, worked by several dozen men, and, because of the recoil of so heavy a stone, needing a cart body or an earthwork to mask it. The sieges in this war are exactly the stage on which such machines performed: after the three columns of 1219 went south, Fancheng, Guangzhou and Huangzhou were all worked over by thrown stones, and Fancheng was stormed for three days without success and then abandoned, thrown stone being the direct means by which the defenders kept the wallheads down and the wall itself intact. The Jin relied on the same devices, with ladders and mining, when they attacked Huangzhou, Qizhou and Hanyang Army, and the two smaller cities fell for that reason. The defenders answered with thrown stone as well: Meng Zongzheng used the pao on the Tang and Deng line to batter the Jin siege gear, and gun positions together with the wall were what let the Song stand against the charge of cavalry. Above and beyond that, the crossbow remained the backbone of the wall, heavy bows of the bed-crossbow and shenbi type covering the gates and the approaches from above; on the gunpowder side there was the thunder-crash bomb, which threw fragments of iron or of stone and is already recorded at the battle of Chu prefecture in 1211, a line of development entirely separate from the counterweight trebuchet and showing that siege technology by then ran on more than one path. On both sides the foot wore hide and lamellar armour, the Jurchen horse was heavily laden and powerful in the charge, and the Han foot relied on long spear, blade and shield to hold its line. The consumption of a siege was enormous: grain had to be dragged from Zhongdu and Henan to the front, horses were taken on the spot or pressed into service, and the Jin records are full of armies turning back for want of grain; crossing the Huai depended on wooden bridges thrown up in haste, and once such a bridge broke it became a disaster for the whole army.
tactics: 金軍的戰法是一條典型的三路分進：西路出唐、鄧，北趨襄漢；中路出蔡、息，向商洛、襄陽方向壓進；東路自宿州南下，先取泗州再逼濠州，企圖讓襄漢與兩淮同時受壓，逼宋軍分兵。騎兵負責機動、追擊與斷糧線，砲與雲梯、穴地一類攻城具負責攻坚，故金軍每次進攻都以攻點與糧道能否延續為關鍵。1219年秋天金軍在棗陽、大安軍一線受挫，宋軍夜間突入金營，殺傷萬計；同年十月，趙方在金軍屢敗之際先發制人，遣扈再興、許國、孟宗政六萬人分三路北攻，並明令毋深入、毋攻城，只潰其保甲、毀其城砦、空其資糧——這是以破壞代替攻城的消耗戰，目的在於逼金軍因糧盡而退。三路受挫後，宋軍反攻鄧州、唐州與湖陽不克，金軍乘勢追至樊城急攻三日不下，見宋軍城上砲位齊備、守軍有備，乃北退。1220年八九月，宋遣安丙所部將分道出大散關、子午谷、上津等地，與西夏二十萬眾會於鞏州、秦州城下，實行宋軍攻城、夏軍野戰的分工，結果攻城不克而還，這是宋夏聯合作戰的第一次實地試驗，代價卻是同時得罪兩方。1221年金軍再攻光州、黃州、蘄州與漢陽軍，採砲擊、封渡口、斷援軍的辦法，先破兩座小城，卻為宋將扈再興在天長邀擊，四月渡淮北去。1222年訛可奉命節制三路軍馬，渡淮破高塘市宋軍、攻固始、破廬州將焦思忠之兵，回師卻在距淮二十里處停留三日收麥，被宋將李全乘夜襲擊，浮橋被衝斷，士卒覆沒。就全局看，金朝以三線作戰對抗兩線受敵，是這場戰爭最根本的戰略錯誤：北方既要擋蒙古，南方又要分兵，力分則兩頭不救。
tacticsEn: The Jin method was a classic three-column advance: the western column out of Tang and Deng driving north towards the Xiang-Han region; the central column out of Cai and Xi pressing towards Shangluo and Xiangyang; the eastern column descending from Suzhou, taking Suzhou prefecture first and then bearing down on Haozhou. The intention was to bring the Xiang-Han region and the two Huai under simultaneous pressure and force the Song to spread itself thin. Cavalry was given the tasks of manoeuvre, pursuit and cutting the grain road, while thrown stone with ladders and mining carried the work of the siege, so that the Jin advance always turned on whether the point of attack and the supply line could be sustained together. In the autumn of 1219 the Jin were checked on the Zaoyang and Daan line, the Song falling on the camp by night and inflicting heavy loss; in the same tenth month, with the Jin repeatedly defeated, Zhao Fang struck first and sent Huo Zaixing, Xu Guo and Meng Zongzheng north with sixty thousand men in three columns, ordering them explicitly not to penetrate deeply and not to besiege cities, but only to break the garrisons, destroy the forts and empty the stores. It was a war of attrition substituted for a war of siege, meant to force the Jin to withdraw for want of grain. After the three columns were checked, the Song counter-attacks on Deng, Tang and Huyang all failed, and the Jin, riding the advantage, pursued to Fancheng and stormed it for three days without success; seeing the gun positions on the wall in good order and the garrison alert, they withdrew north. In the eighth and ninth months of 1220 the Song, under An Bing, sent officers out by Da San Pass, the Valley of Zi and Shangjin, and met a Xia host of two hundred thousand beneath the walls of Gong and Qin, Song troops to do the siege and Xia troops to fight in the open; the walls were not taken and the attempt was abandoned, the first field trial of a Song-Xia combined offensive, at the price of offending both partners. In 1221 the Jin attacked Guangzhou, Huangzhou, Qizhou and Hanyang Army again, combining thrown stone with the closing of the crossings and the cutting of reinforcements; they took the two smaller cities first, but were intercepted at Tianchang by the Song general Huo Zaixing and crossed back over the Huai in the fourth month. In 1222 Nelcuo was ordered to take charge of the three columns, crossed the Huai, broke the Song army at Gaotang market, took Guishi and destroyed the troops of the Luzhou commander Jiao Sizhong, and then on the return halted for three days to gather wheat some twenty li from the river, where Li Quan attacked at night, the floating bridge was carried away and the army drowned. In strategic terms the root error was three lines of operations against enemies on two: the north had to hold off the Mongols and the south had to be divided, and a force split in two can rescue neither.
data: 可核對的數字大致可以分三類。第一類是官修史書的紀年：金宣宗1216年二月下詔伐宋，1217年四月以歲幣不至為由命烏古論慶壽經略南邊，1219年以僕散安貞分兵三路，是本場戰爭的主戰年份；1219年十月趙方遣三將北攻，1220年正月宋軍反攻鄧州、唐州、孟宗政敗金於湖陽，同年八九月宋夏會師秦鞏，1221年二月至三月金軍圍光州、黃州、漢陽軍，四月渡淮北去，1222年四月訛可渡淮，1224年三月金遣使至滁州通好。第二類是雙方記載的兵數與戰果：宋軍北攻之兵為六萬，分屬三將；孟宗政在棗陽夜入金營，自晡至三更殺金眾三萬，追至馬磴寨，擒金千戶趙興兒；許國部將耶律均於比陽殺金將李提控；1216年四月僕散安貞破黃、蘄等州，俘宋宗室男女七十餘口；唐州一役宋軍戰死七百餘人；1220年九月西夏以樞密使甯子寧率眾二十萬圍鞏州；金軍攻樊城急攻三日不下；1222年李全在淮上襲擊金軍，浮橋壞，士卒覆沒，金人自記兵財大竭。第三類是戰局層面的概括語：《金史》說金軍南伐之後樞府武騎盡於南伐、士馬折耗十不一存，《大金國志》引孫大鼎語，謂我國兵較北誠不如，較南則制之有餘力。此外可注意的時序背景是1219年十二月蒙古軍已下潼關與京兆，金朝同時面對南北兩面用兵。攻城器械的具體數量、單次攻城的傷亡與糧秣消耗，官修史書多不載，可考的只有樊城三日不克、漢陽軍抵長江而還這類斷定性的記載，學界至今沒有可靠的統計。
dataEn: The checkable figures fall roughly into three classes. The first is the chronology of the official histories: the Xuanzong ordered the campaign against Song in the second month of 1216; in the fourth month of 1217 he took the unpaid tribute as a pretext and put Wugulun Qinghou in charge of the southern front; in 1219 he appointed Pus'an Anzhen to command three columns, and that is the main year of this war. In the tenth month of 1219 Zhao Fang sent his three generals north; in the first month of 1220 the Song counter-attacked at Deng and Tang and Meng Zongzheng beat the Jin at Huyang; in the eighth and ninth months of the same year Song and Xia met beneath Qin and Gong; between the second and third months of 1221 the Jin invested Guangzhou, Huangzhou and Hanyang Army and crossed back over the Huai in the fourth; in the fourth month of 1222 Nelcuo crossed the Huai; and in the third month of 1224 the Jin sent an envoy to Chuzhou to propose peace. The second class is the numbers of men and the results recorded by both sides: the Song army sent north numbered sixty thousand, divided among three generals; Meng Zongzheng entered the Jin camp at night at Zaoyang, from the late afternoon until the third watch, and killed some thirty thousand of the enemy, pursuing them to the Mateng stockade and taking the Jin commander of a thousand, Zhao Xing'er; Xu Guo's officer Yelü Jun killed the Jin commander Li the Controller at Biyang; in the fourth month of 1216 Pus'an Anzhen took Huang, Qi and other prefectures and carried off more than seventy members of the Song royal clan, male and female; in the fighting on the borders of Tang prefecture seven hundred Song soldiers were dead; in the ninth month of 1220 Western Xia sent its privy commissioner Ning Zining with two hundred thousand men to surround Gong prefecture; the Jin stormed Fancheng for three days without taking it; and in 1222 Li Quan attacked the Jin on the Huai, the floating bridge broke, the men were drowned, and the Jin themselves recorded that their troops and treasure were exhausted. The third class is the summary language of the overall situation: the History of Jin says that after the campaign in the south the armoured cavalry of the Privy Council was spent and that of the horses and men not one in ten survived, and the Great Jin Record quotes Sun Dading to the effect that our troops are honestly inferior in the north but have the surplus of strength to rule in the south. One further chronological point is worth noting: by the twelfth month of 1219 the Mongol army had already taken Tong Pass and Jingzhao, so that the Jin were fighting on two fronts at once. The number of siege engines used, the losses in any single assault and the grain consumed are not recorded in the official histories; all that can be checked are the determinate statements that Fancheng held for three days and that the advance to Hanyang Army stopped at the Yangtze, and no reliable statistics exist.
cause: 打起來的起因是多層的。最外層是金朝在北方崩得太快：1211至1213年野狐嶺一線對蒙古連敗，1214年宣宗被迫放棄中都南遷汴京，1215年中都陷落，河北諸郡多失，金朝被迫把國策從守北改成守南，而再退一步就只剩一條線可守。往下一層是財政與兵源的道理：金朝失去北方稅源之後，軍糧軍需大量依賴河南、陕西的簽軍與就地徵發，宣宗朝又連年旱災，《金史》所記曲赦河南路、禁京城兵器、罷新簽民軍一類詔令，說明國家財政與兵源都已到極限；1216年二月下詔伐宋、1217年再以歲幣不至為名開戰，都是在這樣的背景下把虧空轉嫁到南方。政事層面同樣起作用：宣宗性猜忌，內廷連年誅殺重臣，前線將領屢被牽連，1219年末又誅術虎高琪，統帥體系為之削弱。最後是時機：1219年成吉思汗大軍西征花剌子模，金朝北方壓力短暫減輕，宣宗趁這個窗口分兵南出；宋廷則在1214年罷除歲幣卻不願出兵，只對蒙古保持中立，等於默許金朝把戰爭轉過來。南宋自身的困局也說明它為何只能以守待攻：財政困乏、軍額不足，關鍵城池的守備靠當地制置使、臨時召集的兵將與民兵撐住，野戰能力有限，所以一旦金軍壓到城牆之下，宋廷的選項多半只有死守一途。
causeEn: The causes work on several layers. The outermost is that the Jin collapsed in the north far too quickly: they were beaten repeatedly by the Mongols on the Yehuling line between 1211 and 1213, the Xuanzong was forced to abandon Zhongdu and move south to Bianjing in 1214, Zhongdu fell in 1215, most of the prefectures of Hebei were lost, and the Jin were compelled to turn their policy from holding the north to holding the south, with only one line of retreat left behind that. Below that lies the arithmetic of finance and manpower: with the northern revenues gone, the army's grain and supplies came increasingly from the qianjun levies and the exactions of Henan and Shaanxi, and the reign of the Xuanzong was afflicted by repeated droughts; the edicts recording pardons in the Henan circuit, the ban on weapons in the capital and the discharge of newly levied citizen troops show a state at the end of its resources. The order to attack Song in the second month of 1216, and the renewed war in 1217 on the pretext of unpaid tribute, were both attempts to transfer the deficit southward. The political level matters as well: the Xuanzong was jealous by nature, the inner court was purged repeatedly, commanders in the field were repeatedly implicated, and the execution of Shuohu Gaoqi at the end of 1219 weakened the command structure. Last of all comes the opportunity: in 1219 the Great Khan set out west against the Khwarazmians, the pressure on the Jin from the north eased for a time, and the Xuanzong used that window to send columns south. The Song court, for its part, had struck out the tribute in 1214 but would not take the field, and merely held itself neutral towards the Mongols, which amounted to letting the Jin turn the war in that direction. The straits of the Southern Song explain why it could only wait and defend: exhausted finances, short establishments, and the defence of the key cities resting on the local circuit commanders, hastily raised troops and militia, with little capacity in the open field, so that once the Jin came up against the wall the court's options were few and the main one was to hold at all costs.
impact: 這場戰爭對金朝是加速器，對南宋則是一次成功的消耗。金朝這一邊，1219至1222年的南征把最後一點精銳消耗在襄漢與兩淮的城牆之下，《金史·宣宗本紀》的贊語說得很直接：南開宋釁，西啟夏侮，兵力既分，功不補患。北方同時被蒙古撕開缺口，1219年蒙古軍已下潼關、京兆，1220年代金朝在陝西、山西與河南的防線不斷後撤，1224年哀宗為了集中力量對付蒙古，與宋夏議和收兵，卻已比蒙古所需的多爭了三年的喘息。三年後金主力在三峰山覆滅，1234年蔡州失守，金朝亡國，時間上正好接得上。宋朝這一邊，是宋金戰爭最後一段成功的守城戰：京湖制置司的體制、趙方那種先發制人的分路反攻、孟宗政在唐鄧打游擊並編組忠順軍的做法，都在此戰中定型；宋軍的砲位運用與城防配合經此一役積累的經驗，後來在孟珙手上對金、對蒙古都用得上，襄樊抗蒙數年、屢用砲擊退攻城器械，源頭正落在這批城防經驗上。戰役的社會面向同樣具體：中原遺民大批歸宋，編入忠順軍或散居兩淮，邊疆線上的人口流動成為南宋中期最難處理的一個問題。技術史上，這幾年反覆的攻城與反攻城，把配重拋石車這類器械的射程、精度與破壞力推到實戰極限，後來蒙古軍於一二七〇年代初襄樊之役中自西域引進同類拋石車並用於攻城，是同一條技術路線的延伸，而不是另一條路。歷史評價上，宣宗朝被公認為金末最壞的一個時期，敗因不在無兵，而在分兵、用兵與用砲都用在錯的地方。
impactEn: For the Jin this war was an accelerant; for the Southern Song it was a successful grinding. On the Jin side, the campaigns of 1219 to 1222 spent the last of their hard troops against the walls of the Xiang-Han region and the two Huai, and the appraisal in the annals of the Xuanzong puts it plainly: opening a feud with Song in the south and provoking Xia in the west divides the forces and achieves nothing. The north was being torn open by the Mongols at the same time; the Mongol army had already taken Tong Pass and Jingzhao by the twelfth month of 1219, and through the 1220s the Jin lines in Shaanxi, Shanxi and Henan drew steadily backwards. In 1224 the Aizong, wanting to concentrate everything against the Mongols, made peace with Song and Xia and withdrew, having bought three years more of breathing space than the Mongols needed. Three years later the Jin main force was destroyed at Sanfengshan, and Caizhou fell in 1234 and the dynasty was gone, the sequence fitting one to the other. On the Song side this was the last successful defensive campaign of the Song-Jin wars: the organisation of the Jinghu circuit command, Zhao Fang's habit of striking first in separated columns, and Meng Zongzheng's practice of harrying the enemy on the Tang-Deng line and enrolling the Zhongshun army were all settled here. The experience of placing guns and coordinating them with the walls, accumulated in this campaign, was used later by Meng Gong against both Jin and Mongol, and the years of resistance at Xiangfan, in which thrown stone repeatedly drove off the siege gear of the attackers, trace directly back to this body of defensive practice. The social side is just as concrete: refugees from the central plain came south in large numbers, were enrolled in the Zhongshun army or scattered along the two Huai, and the movement of population along the frontier became one of the hardest problems of the middle Southern Song. In the history of technology, the repeated sieges and counter-sieges of these years pushed the range, accuracy and destructive power of engines such as the counterweight trebuchet to the limit of what could be achieved in the field, and the Mongols later brought a machine of the same kind west from Central Asia and used it in the sieges of Xiangfan in the early 1270s, an extension of the same line of development rather than a different one. In historical judgement the reign of the Xuanzong is agreed to be the worst decade of the late Jin, and the cause of the ruin was not a lack of soldiers but the fact that the armies were divided, and the soldiers and the stones both used in the wrong places.
result: 打到最後，雙方都沒有拿到想要的東西。金軍三道攻勢在1219年秋天就撞在棗陽與大安軍：宋軍夜間突入金營，殺金眾三萬，金人不敗而自退；同年十月宋軍先發制人，三路北攻雖然在鄧州、唐州、湖陽都碰了硬釘子，金軍追至樊城卻攻不下，砲火與守軍把三日猛攻擋了回去，北退。1220年宋夏夾攻秦州、鞏州，兩軍會師而攻城不克，試驗以失敗收場。1221年金軍再攻光州、黃州、蘄州與漢陽軍，先破黃州與蘄州，守將何大節自沈於江，李誠之全家赴水，但宋將扈再興於天長邀擊，金軍四月渡淮北去。1222年訛可節制三路軍馬再渡淮，在高塘市擊破官軍、攻固始、破廬州將焦思忠之兵，看似得手，回師卻在距淮二十里處停留三日收麥，被李全乘夜襲擊，浮橋衝斷，士卒大部覆沒，金人自認兵財大竭，此役之後再無能力大舉南下。1224年三月金主遣尚書令史李唐英至滁州通好，又遣樞密判官移剌蒲阿至光州榜諭軍民不再南侵，戰事收束。回頭看，這場戰爭的勝負其實由攻城器械與守城工程決定了一半：樊城能守三日不破，靠的是城垣高度、砲位配置與趙方、扈再興的督率；黃州、蘄州兩座小城先破，靠的是城小、砲少而守將力竭。金朝用盡最後的騎兵去撞南宋的城牆，換不到一個渡江的據點，反而把北方防線的真空留給了蒙古。南方守住江山，北方輸掉整個國家，這是1219到1224年間最冷的一筆帳。
resultEn: In the end neither side got what it wanted. The three-column offensive of the Jin struck the Zaoyang and Daan line as early as the autumn of 1219: the Song fell on the camp by night and killed some thirty thousand of the enemy, and the Jin withdrew without being defeated; in the same tenth month the Song struck first, and although the three columns northward met hard metal at Deng, Tang and Huyang, the Jin could not take Fancheng when they reached it, thrown stone and the garrison turned back three days of assault, and they withdrew north. In 1220 Song and Xia closed on Qin and Gong, met, and failed to take the walls, and the experiment ended in failure. In 1221 the Jin attacked Guangzhou, Huangzhou, Qizhou and Hanyang Army once more, taking the two smaller cities first, He Dajie drowning himself in the river and Li Chengzhi taking his family into the water, but the Song general Huo Zaixing intercepted them at Tianchang and the Jin crossed back over the Huai in the fourth month. In 1222 Nelcuo was ordered to take charge of the three columns and cross the Huai again, breaking the imperial troops at Gaotang market, taking Guishi and destroying the troops of the Luzhou commander Jiao Sizhong, and seeming to have won; but on the return the army halted for three days to gather wheat some twenty li from the river, Li Quan attacked by night, the floating bridge was carried away and the greater part of the army drowned, and the Jin themselves conceded that their men and treasure were exhausted, and after this they had no strength left to invade on a great scale. In the third month of 1224 the Jin ruler sent the minister of state Shi Liying to Chuzhou to talk peace, and the privy council judge of the privy council Cuan Buhu was sent to Guangzhou to proclaim to soldiers and people that there would be no more southward raids, and the fighting was closed. Looking back, half the outcome of this war was in fact decided by siege engines and by the engineering of the defence: Fancheng held for three days because of the height of its walls, the placement of its gun positions and the direction of Zhao Fang and Huo Zaixing; the two smaller cities of Huangzhou and Qizhou fell because they were small, had few guns, and their commanders were spent. The Jin spent the last of their cavalry on the walls of the Southern Song and bought not a single foothold south of the river, and left a vacuum in the northern defences for the Mongols. The south kept its realm; the north lost the whole state. That is the coldest ledger of the years from 1219 to 1224.
